Description: Set of APIs to test audio playback and recording functionality

APIs.Description: Sets the volume on a specified device

InputArguments.Name: Endpoint
InputArguments.Description: Friendly name of endpoint. Case sensitive, but can be partial name
Type of volume query.
InputArguments.Name: Type

InputArguments.Description: Volume level. In dB for type=db, or scalar in range [0,1] for type=scalar.
InputArguments.Name: VolumeLevel

InputArguments.Description: Friendly name of endpoint. Case sensitive, but can be partial name

Result.Description: Volume level. In dB for type=db, or scalar in range [0,1] for type=scalar.
